means: A third code generator. 319 functions on both, 167 more instructions here than xPack 15.2.1's 12441, and text 39604 against 39212 and ARM GNU 14.3.1's 39172. So the codegen axis d7876b1 says moved from within a bench to between benches has three benches on it, not two.
not_claimed: That 14.2.1 and 14.3.1 differ on the functions that matter. The whole-image hashes differ from xPack; the per-function diff against ARM GNU 14.3.1 needs their hashes, which are not published. CLAUDE.md is deliberately NOT edited on this yet.
open_question: Does 14.2.1 side with 14.3.1 or with 15.2.1, per function? It matters for #5: linux-x1 and windows-desk have DIFFERENT generated code and the SAME site set (Jaccard 0.862 against 0.885 repeatability), while 14.3.1 vs 15.2.1 have different code and different sites (0.154). If that holds, 'the site set follows the generated code' is too strong and the real discriminator is narrower.

the_18.scope: the functions windows-desk found differing between ARM GNU 14.3.1 and xPack 15.2.1
